text: Reminder: Stripe is our primary payment provider. INR orders go to Razorpay, everything else to Stripe. PayPal is wallet-only.
Adding a new provider is easy — implement the PaymentProvider interface (charge / refund / verify_webhook) and add it to PROVIDERS in code/payment_providers.py.
If Stripe webhooks return 400 in staging it's usually STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET being stale after a key rotation — see PAY-19.
Auth is JWT-based: a 15-minute access token plus a 7-day refresh token. Passwords are bcrypt-hashed. Google social login lives at /auth/google.
Heads up: logout doesn't revoke refresh tokens yet (AUTH-15). Access tokens still expire in 15 minutes, so the window is small.
New-joiner setup tip: run `docker compose up -d postgres redis` and wait ~5s before `make migrate`, or you'll hit 'connection refused' (DEV-3).
Local setup is all in setup.md: venv + pip install -r requirements.txt, cp .env.example .env, make migrate, make run. API + docs at http://localhost:8000/docs.
Deploy access is managed by the platform team. Open a request here — never share prod credentials or Stripe live keys in DMs.
